build_file_dataset_builder: build a FileDatasetBuilder that processes PDFs and images from a source folder into ground-truth dataset records
create_file_dataset_instance: create a FileDatasetBuilder instance with a source directory, target path, and custom file extensions
iterate_dataset_records: iterate through a FileDatasetBuilder to yield DatasetRecord objects for each PDF or image file
process_pdf_files: process PDF files from a directory into DoclingDocument ground-truth records with extracted page images
process_image_files: process image files like PNG and JPEG into single-page DoclingDocument ground-truth records
